title: Outreach in the admin panel: campaigns and settings
question: The first Outreach page for leaders at a desk: the campaigns (General outreach, Carols 2026, a mission), the settings walks run on (rest period, pace, bundles, what's kept), and where the follow-ups and reports that notifications open land. The planner, coverage map and day board come later as their own tabs. Owner asleep 2026-11-14: the station built C, Campaigns as the workbench (marked Built): campaigns are records staff create and delete, so they take the Workbench, and settings take grouped cards like every settings page. Pick another and it changes.

options.label: Settings in a column beside the campaigns
options.thesis: One Campaigns and settings tab: the settings groups stand in a narrow column on the left, always in view, and the campaigns workbench (list and the chosen campaign) fills the rest. Follow-ups and Reports are their own tabs.
options.viewport: Outreach, Campaigns and settings tab: Rest period, Walking and Keeping groups on the left; General outreach, Carols 2026 and Gympie mission in the list; Carols 2026 open on the right.
options.risk: Two forms side by side, each with its own Save; a narrow settings column squeezes the number fields.

options.label: One page of settings, campaigns a group in it
options.thesis: Outreach opens on grouped settings cards the full width of the pane, as a ministry's Settings does: Campaigns first as a list in its own card (each opening a sheet), then How walks are worked out, Rest period, What's kept. Follow-ups and Reports are tabs.
options.viewport: Outreach, Settings tab: a Campaigns card listing three, then a How walks are worked out card with pace and seconds two to a line, and a Rest period card.
options.risk: Campaigns are things you create and delete, not settings; they get the narrow treatment of a list inside a card.

options.label: Campaigns as the workbench, settings a tab (Built)
options.thesis: Campaigns is the page's main tab: the list in the middle with each campaign's dates and this month's letterboxes, the chosen one in the record pane with its details and its own totals. Settings is a tab of grouped cards; Follow-ups and Reports are tabs with the same workbench.
options.viewport: Outreach, Campaigns tab: a table of three campaigns with dates, what's handed out and letterboxes this month; Carols 2026 open on the right with its dates, area regions, leaderboard switch and Cancel and Save.
options.risk: The settings are a tab away, so a leader changing the rest period doesn't see the campaigns it affects.
